description: Decodes an HTTP 402 payment challenge (x402) into a plain explanation of what the server is asking for: how much, what asset, which chain, who to pay, and what to sign. Paste the raw 402 response body or the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value.

challenge.description: The raw 402 response body, OR the value of the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64-encoded x402 challenge)

name: read-this-challenge
